To address this, we propose PRIMS, a physics-aware multimodal Transformer that integrates physical knowledge into rep…

items.originalTitle: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
items.summary: 本文测量了LLM智能体添加技能后的正反两面，通过近6000次运行发现回归（技能使任务失败）显著。识别了三种回归原因：技能描述渗透、接地位移和验证位移。最佳技能主要因其回归更少而非增益更多。分析发现现有技能过度强调程序指导，对接地和验证支持不足，许多错误可通过更好接地和验证恢复。

However, this metric hides an important cost: skills can also make agents worse. We measure both sides by comparing agents with and without skills across nearly 6,000 runs spanning two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. 通过比较有无技能的智能体在近6000次运行中的表现，分解净效应为增益和回归，并分析轨迹和评估伪影以识别回归原因。

items.summary: 研究在法布里-珀罗腔中心放置光子晶体Fano膜的光机械系统。与传统介质膜不同，Fano膜支持局域光学共振，与腔场杂化实现光谱工程。考虑透明膜和反射膜两种极限情况。在反射膜情形，仅对称腔模与Fano模杂化，反对称模退耦。利用量子朗之万方程和传输矩阵方法，证明Fano诱导杂化可产生窄光学简正模，实现边带分辨和基态冷却，即使裸腔处于非分辨边带区。
items.abstract: Conventional membrane-in-the-middle (MIM) optomechanical systems offer limited control over the optical linewidth, which can limit their performance when operating in the unresolved-sideband regime. We investigate cavity optomechanics with a photonic-crystal Fano membrane placed at the center of a Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity. In contrast to a conventional dielectric membrane, the photonic-crystal membrane supports a localized optical resonance, which hybridizes with the cavity field and enables spectral engineering of…
keyFacts: Fano膜如何改善膜居中式光机械系统的光谱控制和边带分辨性能？
通过量子朗之万方程和传输矩阵方法分析光散射问题，研究Fano膜与腔场的杂化效应。
Fano膜可产生窄光学简正模，在裸腔为非分辨边带区时仍能实现边带分辨及膜运动的基态冷却。

items.originalTitle: Exact Neural-Network Representations of the Motzkin States

Specifically, colorless Motzkin states exhibit critical logarithmic entanglement divergence \(\log N\) with system size \(N\), while their colorful counterparts host supercritical sublinear \(\sqrt{N}\) entanglement growth. Such unconventional entanglement behaviors place these states well beyond the expressi…
keyFacts: 如何为具有非面积律纠缠的Motzkin态构造精确的神经网络表示？
基于因果前缀和模块（通过循环更新、前馈映射或掩码注意力实现）和位置选择性ReLU门，对彩色态额外引入因果堆栈模块，构建循环、前馈、卷积和变换器四种神经网络架构的精确表示。

Here we deliberately operate such a lock outside its stable regime: a continuous-wave nitrogen-vacancy (NV) ensemble magnetometer, frequency-modulation (FM) locked to one flank of its optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR), is driven through the flip (period-doubling) bifurcation of its discrete feedback map by raising the software loop gain $G$. Beyond a critical gain $\Gc$ the lock becomes…

通过提高连续波NV色心系综磁力计（频率调制锁定至ODMR一侧）的软件环路增益G，驱动其反馈映射的翻转（倍周期）分岔。

Among known galactic HVSs, only S5-HVS1 has unambiguous galactic-centre origin. Its measured mass and velocity determine a relation between the mass and semi-major axis of its captured companion. GRAVITY has now discovered S301, whose orbit and photometrically inferred mass satisfy this relation, making it the only compelling candidate for the captured com…

items.abstract: Routine cement performance characterization provides continuous quality control data, but its information content for performance inference and transferability across independent producers remains uncertain. This study analyzes 476 cement records from 23 European producers, collected in one laboratory over 27 years, to determine what can be inferred from routine measurements. The analysis focuses on CEM I and combines oxide chemistry, Blaine fineness, particle-size distribution descriptors, physical properties, an…
keyFacts: 常规水泥表征数据对CEM I性能推断的信息含量及跨生产商迁移性如何？

items.abstract: POLLUX is a candidate European instrumental contribution to the Habitable Worlds Observatory. It is a high-resolution spectrograph with polarimetric capabilities, covering from the far ultraviolet (FUV; 100nm) to the near infrared (NIR; 1.75mum). Such a broad spectral coverage is achieved by splitting the instrument into five channels, each comprising an echelle spectrograph: FUV, medium-UV (MUV), near-UV (NUV), optical (OPT), and NIR. A set of custom-made dichroics enables simultaneity across the MUV, NUV, OPT, a…

items.summary: 多数光谱巡天假设局部热力学平衡，但对红巨星失效。本文利用预计算离群系数网格生成Na、Mg等八种元素的非LTE光谱，并训练神经网络模拟器模拟LTE和NLTE的APOGEE H波段光谱。对36万颗红巨星进行拟合，发现Al、Mn、Ti有0.1dex的NLTE效应，并提供校正目录。
items.abstract: The majority of spectroscopic surveys assume local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) during the modeling of stellar spectra. This assumption begins to break down for luminous stars, like the red giants targeted by SDSS-V's Milky Way Mapper Survey in its Galactic Genesis program. In this work, we present non-LTE (NLTE) abundances for 360,000 red giant stars in Milky Way Mapper DR19, from infrared APOGEE spectra. We generate NLTE spectra using precomputed departure coefficient grids for Na, Mg, Si, Al, Ca, Ti, Mn, and…

items.originalTitle: Fractal quantum many-body scars and Hamiltonian inverse design from ZX-calculus
items.summary: ZX演算通常用于电路化简，本文用它构造基于Sierpiński三角形和地毯的分形多体态。三角形家族满足面积律，地毯家族在可用系统尺寸上近似对数标度，局域观测量保留分形空间结构。结合母哈密顿量方法和ZX恒等式，构造了无挫哈密顿量，并通过局域变形产生混沌能谱，将分形ZX态嵌入能谱中部作为精确量子多体疤痕。
